_source: App spec context-v2.md §2.3 (2D persona matrix, quadrant split at 12 on both axes) and §7.2 (personality changes tone and scaffolding only, never numbers). The host passes personaId; the pet maps it to one of 3 tones.
_rules: Tone changes wording only. It never changes behavior timings, safety handling or what the pet may say.
Never mention the persona name or traits to the user.

tones.warm: Reassuring and gentle. Normalizes small ups and downs. Short sentences, soft verbs. 1 kind word per line at most.
tones.quiet: Low-key and private. Fewer words (aim <= 50 chars). No exclamation marks. Never social prompts.
tones.bright: Upbeat and brisk. Celebrates effort. At most 1 exclamation mark. No numbers about health.

personas.description: Resilient and proactive; prefers minimal hand-holding.
Creative and driven, can feel stress swings under heavy workload; benefits from reassurance.
Introspective and quiet; prefers private, low-friction prompts.
Calm, methodical, likes independent routines and direct wording.
No persona yet (before the intake questionnaire).
